# AI Prompt Engineering & GenAI Hub
> Verified directory and real-time knowledge base of online communities for generative AI, Midjourney prompt engineering, ChatGPT workflows, Stable Diffusion, and LLM hacking.

## Key Navigation
- [AI Prompt Engineering & GenAI Hub Directory](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/ai-prompts-generative-hub/): Searchable, filterable database of verified communities across Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, and Reddit.
- [XML Sitemap](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/ai-prompts-generative-hub/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable URL index and crawling priority directives.
- [RSS Syndication Feed](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/ai-prompts-generative-hub/feed.xml): Real-time syndication feed for newly discovered groups and platform updates.

## Coverage
- Discord Servers: Real-time discussions, voice channels, events, and sub-groups.
- Telegram Channels & Groups: Instant alerts, announcements, and peer chats.
- WhatsApp Groups: Focused cohorts and regional professional networks.
- Reddit Subreddits: Community threads, wiki guides, and discussions.

## Quality & Verification
All listed channels undergo authentication checks, link liveness verification, and member activity monitoring.
